intuition: A fixed array with a head index and size can expose both ends without shifting values.

brute_force.approach: Use a list and insert or remove at either end, shifting elements when needed.
brute_force.time: front insertion/deletion O(n), other operations O(1)

optimal.approach: Use a circular array and compute the rear index from head and size.

edge_cases: A zero-size deque is not allowed by the constraints.
Deleting the last value makes both front and rear report empty.
